about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Meet the Visionaries Behind Your Perfect Day
about.description: Founded by Hirwa Patel and Sanjana Upadhyay, The Style Robe is dedicated to transforming your wedding dreams into unforgettable realities. With a passion for detail and a commitment to excellence, we curate every element of your special day.
about.mission: Our mission is to create magical, stress-free wedding experiences that reflect your unique love story. From the first consultation to your last dance, we're with you every step of the way.

faqs.question: Do you work with our existing vendors or source new ones?
faqs.answer: We're flexible! We can work with vendors you've already chosen or help you source new ones from our curated network of trusted professionals.

faqs.question: How does pricing work?
faqs.answer: Pricing varies based on guest count, venue, season, and scope of services. We offer transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Book a free consultation to get a customized quote.

faqs.question: Can we customize a package?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our packages are flexible starting points. We can mix and match services or create a completely custom package based on your needs and budget.

faqs.question: What makes TSR different from other planners?
faqs.answer: Our personalized approach, curated vendor network, attention to detail, and commitment to making your planning journey enjoyable. We're not just planners - we're your partners in creating memories.
